data.name: DeadOcean
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

DeadOcean is a cinematic tropical survival adventure built around photorealistic visuals, immersive exploration, and grounded survival gameplay.

Trapped within a remote island region, you must survive in a world defined by beauty, isolation, and constant danger. Explore coastlines, tropical forests, and open waters as you gather resources, craft essential tools, build shelter, and adapt to the harsh realities of nature.

Every environment is designed to emphasize atmosphere, realism, and visual fidelity — from sunlit beaches and crystal-clear shallows to dense vegetation, rugged rock formations, and unpredictable natural threats. In DeadOcean, survival is not just about endurance, but about reading the world around you, making smart decisions, and pushing deeper into the unknown.

With its strong focus on cinematic presentation, environmental storytelling, and immersive worldbuilding, DeadOcean aims to deliver a premium survival experience where paradise can become a fight for life at any moment.

Key Features

• Photorealistic Tropical World

Discover visually rich islands featuring dense vegetation, dramatic coastlines, pristine waters, and highly atmospheric environments.

• Survive the Dangers of Land and Sea

Endure the threats of wilderness and ocean alike while searching for resources, safety, and a way forward.

• Craft, Build, and Adapt

Collect materials, create essential tools, and construct shelters to withstand the growing challenges of the environment.

• Immersive Open-World Exploration

Travel through remote and dangerous locations in a world that rewards exploration, awareness, and survival instinct.

• Cinematic Survival Experience

Experience a realistic and atmospheric journey shaped by isolation, discovery, and the struggle to stay alive.
